d: Ministry of External Affairs official spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal addressed several foreign policy and geopolitical matters during a media briefing in New Delhi. Announcing ministerial travel, he stated, 'External Affairs Minister will be attending the G20 Foreign Ministers meeting to be held in Atlanta, United States from 30th to 31st October 2026', followed by his visit to Antigua and Barbuda to lead the Indian delegation at the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting.
